name: Manoj Tripathi
shortBio: Manoj has stood at the main gate for six years. He remembers students by the way they walk, long before he learns their names.
quote: Some students I know just by the way they walk.

name: Santosh Kumar
shortBio: Santosh starts work before most students wake up. By the time the first classes begin, the corridors he cleaned are already being used.
quote: The campus is already awake before anyone sees it.

name: Devsharan
shortBio: Devsharan has been working here since 2011, mostly in the hostel blocks, fixing windows, doors, and whatever needs repairing.
quote: Tools go missing all the time here. You leave a plier in the corridor for a minute, and it just disappears.

name: Vicky Kumar
shortBio: Vicky runs the counter after most of the campus has gone quiet, when the only students still around are the ones who stayed up too late.
quote: I know their orders before they know they're hungry.

name: Satya Mitra Arya
shortBio: Satya Mitra Arya is famous across the campus as the 'Momos and Chai waale Uncle'. He serves the night canteen with warmth.
quote: Momos/chai waale uncle ke naam se famous hai.
